description: "Two Wonderful Detectives; Or, Jack and Gil's Marvelous Skill" by Old Sleuth is a detective novel written in the late 19th century. The book introduces twin detectives Jack and Gil Alvarez, who take on a peculiar case involving a vast fortune that has remained unclaimed for forty years.
